## Post-deploy evidence so far, 2026-11-22 18:15 PST. Remaining work: the last criterion.

- Deploy 1 after the fix: the review-bot was redeployed at 17:54:20 PST on 13d4a73cde2, which contains 1bfd389af7e. It was deferred for 1561 s (inside the 2400 s bound) while a pre-fix review finished, then deployed with no AUTODEPLOY_REVIEW_INTERRUPT marker.
- At 18:15 PST, 21 minutes into the new container, its startup sweep is walking the disk (1 bot thread in `xfs_buf_lock`) while `/proc/locks` shows no holder of `bytes.total.lock`. Before the fix, the same moment showed the lock held with review threads queued on it. This shows the walk no longer holds the lock.
- No review has run in the new container yet, so the journal has no `review_step` lines yet.

Baseline for the last criterion (autodeploy journal): 6 bound-exceeded interrupts from 11-20 13:11 to 11-21 10:03 PST. Review timeouts per PST day: 11-20 5, 11-21 6, 11-22 at least 4, all pre-fix (11-22: 16:45 and 17:05 in the 16:20 container, plus earlier ones).

Remaining (last criterion, left open): watch the autodeploy and review-bot journals over the next burst of at least 5 review-bot deploys for zero bound-exceeded interrupts and at most 1 review timeout per day. Deploy 1 of 5 is clean. No deploys will be triggered just to satisfy this.
